column1: # The lexicon extension of en (en/src/lexgrow.rs, `en lexgrow`): form, PTB tag, lemma (`=`: the form itself), sources.
# Sources: o = Open English WordNet 2025 (McCrae et al.; CC BY 4.0, crediting Princeton WordNet and the OEWN team);
# s:<EUI> = the SPECIALIST Lexicon, 2026 release (U.S. National Library of Medicine, SPECIALIST NLP Tools Terms and Conditions),
#   rows selected from LRAGR (single-word nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs) and mapped to PTB tags;
# c = 2010 U.S. Census surnames (public domain), as proper nouns; k = given names of the Names Corpus (Mark Kantrowitz,
#   its README below), as proper nouns. Only rows the dictionary (data/forms.tsv) lacks.
# The Names Corpus README, as its terms ask for when the list is redistributed:
#   This corpus contains 5001 female names and 2943 male names, sorted
#   You may use the lists of names for any purpose, so long as credit is
#   given in any published work. You may also redistribute the list if you
#   provide the recipients with a copy of this README file. The lists are
#   not in the public domain (I retain the copyright on the lists) but are
#   freely redistributable.  If you have any additions to the lists of
#   names, I would appreciate receiving them.
# License: CC BY 4.0 for the OEWN-derived rows; the rest public domain or SPECIALIST terms; selection ours.
